planner_json.title: Implement the claude-code CanonicalEvent stream mapping, the per-version mapping validator, and question-boundary semantics (ask-nothing + FirstQuestion boundary-stop)

requirements.title: Four grades per graded cell: command_list, status, verify, question_before_expensive_work — ask-nothing enforced, must-a
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Fixture pair: claude-code pinned cell with four pass verdicts where list/status/verify streams contain zero question events and the init prefix stops at the first USER_CHOICE with no answer sent — module exits 0.

would_fail_if: a question event appeared in any list/status/verify stream and the grader still passed that check (an empty question count must fail ask-nothing)
the must-ask probe graded pass with zero question events or with an answer delivered
a generic status reply passed the status check
verdicts were derived from exit codes instead of streams

forms: CanonicalEvent streams with original_event bytes and offsets
archived real captures with provenance hashes
examples: four check_ids with verdicts for claude-code/pinned
question event count 0 in ask-nothing streams
USER_CHOICE count 1, answers sent 0 in must-ask
evidence.required_capture: raw captured stdout per invocation with byte offsets, capture hashes, grader evidence citations

steps: adapter runs the five real invocations via claude -p with stream-json
grader assigns four verdicts from files and streams

must_observe: status reply states platform "web-desktop", seeded phase, gate state, nonzero inventory counts matching StatusCase
must-ask capture contains exactly 1 valid USER_CHOICE and 0 answer deliveries
must_not_observe: any question event in list/status/verify streams
a scripted answer consumed by any first check
an empty checks array or null reason on a pass verdict

steps: node tests/sprint-01/flow-runner.mjs grd-02 --fixture question-in-ask-nothing --expect red

must_observe: grader returns "fail" citing the question event offset
must_not_observe: pass on a stream containing a question
synthetic event JSON with no capture provenance

scenario.topology_note: real claude-code CLI executes list/status/planted-verify/clean-verify/must-ask-init; keyless grader reads files plus CanonicalEvent streams; replay runs the same grader over archived real captures

requirements.red_input: On base main the module cannot find any grade record (no test/harness exists) and exits 1 writing .red; locally, a fixture where the status check's stream contains a question flips verdict to fail.
requirements.description: GIVEN seed/live-dispatch-run (RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download) WHEN adapter runs the five real invocations via claude -p with stream-json; grader assigns four verdicts from files and streams THEN claude-code/pinned cell shows all 4 checks "pass"; status reply states platform "web-desktop", seeded phase, gate state, nonzero inventory counts matching StatusCase; must-ask capture contains exactly 1 valid USER_CHOICE and 0 answer deliveries

requirements.title: Evidence-not-exit-code grading: verdicts cite files and stream offsets; a denied read fails on exit 0
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Controls row exit0-denied-read fail denied_tool_call present next to a raw process_exit_code of 0, and every graded check citing at least 1 evidence path — module exits 0.

would_fail_if: a denied required read with exit 0 graded pass — the real exit0-denied-read capture yields fail denied_tool_call
an unmapped required fact silently omitted — version-bumped capture yields could-not-run
the stored exit code could influence the verdict

examples: source files-and-event-stream count == 4
process_exit_code 0 next to verdict fail
denied_tool_call naming operation and target path
evidence.required_capture: the raw exit-0 denial capture from T11 qualification with before/after fixture manifests

steps: download result artifact
jq claude-code/pinned checks for source and process_exit_code

must_not_observe: any check where verdict equals an exit-code mapping
pass verdict with non-empty denied_tool_call
opaque events used to infer absence

steps: node tests/sprint-01/flow-runner.mjs grd-03 --fixture exit0-denied-read --expect red

must_observe: verdict fail with denied_tool_call citing the denial offset while process_exit_code reads 0
must_not_observe: pass or could-not-run on an observable denial
fabricated denial events with no capture provenance

scenario.topology_note: InvocationCapture records stdout with byte offsets; stream-grader normalizes to CanonicalEvent; grader cites offsets and capture hashes; live artifact carries source and process_exit_code per check

requirements.red_input: Base main: no grader exists, module exits 1 with .red. Behavior RED: a verdict equal to its exit-code mapping (pass with exit 0 and a denied-read stream) makes the module exit 1 — the negative fixture is the recorded deny-under-default-mode stream from T5.
requirements.description: GIVEN seed/live-dispatch-run (RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download) WHEN download result artifact; jq claude-code/pinned checks for source and process_exit_code THEN checks with .source files-and-event-stream count == 4; raw integer `process_exit_code` present as diagnostic; controls row exit0-denied-read fail denied_tool_call
Every required fact in a qualified capture maps to a CanonicalEvent type, and an unmapped required fact makes the affected check could-not-run

seed/live-dispatch-run.entrypoint: gh workflow run harness-eval --repo hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect (real dispatch, checkout default)
seed/live-dispatch-run.description: RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download

seed/result-artifact.description: harness-eval-result.json with cells, controls, pins_sha256, identity fields

seed/streams/exit0-denied-read.entrypoint: real claude-code capture from T11 qualification (recorded-stance run, reads denied, exit 0); archived under test/harness/fixtures/streams/ with capture hash

seed/streams/clean-verify-pass.entrypoint: real captured clean-verify invocation from the same qualification run

seed/streams/question-in-ask-nothing.entrypoint: splice of real bytes only: USER_CHOICE from the must-ask capture inserted into the real verify stream, provenance hashes recorded

seed/case/verify-button-drift.entrypoint: test/harness/kit/project fresh copy + overlays/button-drift by the case loader
seed/case/verify-button-drift.description: planted invocation dir with declared report path

seed/case/verify-clean.entrypoint: same kit copy without overlay, separate fresh dir

seed/scratch-invocation-dir.entrypoint: mkdtemp created by the case loader
seed/scratch-invocation-dir.description: empty workspace for confinement negatives with post-run listings

seed/env/anthropic-key-present.entrypoint: harness-smoke environment, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on exec steps (owner secret)

seed/env/key-removed.entrypoint: control step's real environment with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and all fallbacks unset (asserted in-step)
seed/env/key-removed.description: missing-key refusal capture with zero model events
